request.prompt: A red-tailed hawk (Buteo jamaicensis), one adult bird soaring in mid-air, wings fully spread out flat to the sides and symmetrical, about 125 cm wingspan and 55 cm long, shaped to read from below and from above. Broad rounded wings with a straight leading edge and five separated, fingered primary feathers at each wingtip. Short, broad brick-red tail fanned wide into a rounded fan. Legs and feet tucked up under the body. Big rounded head and short hooked bill projecting ahead of the wings. Pale underwing with a dark leading-edge bar and a dark wrist mark, pale breast with a dark belly band. Not an eagle, not a falcon. Single bird, no base, no perch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.
